args.title: Ensure weekly summary dispatch respects user time zones
args.body:
File: src/util/dates.ts

The code for calculating the start of the week (`startOfWeek`) does not take time zones into account when determining the local week start. This may cause inconsistencies in dispatch times for weekly summaries, leading to delayed arrival. The method should be updated to correctly use the `tz` parameter to adjust the week start date according to the user's local time zone.
